entries.title: Vacation Schedule 2025 (Hebrew)
entries.covers: 2025 scheduled closures and shortened-session date ranges
entries.notes: The complete one-page TASE table states Sunday-Thursday trading, lists every 2025 vacation date, and identifies 14-17 April and 8-12 October as shortened trading days.

entries.title: TASE Board Resolutions of 15 February 2024
entries.covers: equity trading hours, including intermediate Passover and Sukkot sessions
entries.notes: Page 17 gives 14:30 as the end of the TAL closing-price phase on Passover and Sukkot intermediate trading days.

entries.title: Modification of Tel Aviv Stock Exchange Trading Days Guide
entries.covers: new Monday-Friday trading week effective 5 January 2026 and Friday hours
entries.notes: Pages 7 and 30 set the effective date and Monday-Friday week; pages 17-19 and 30 set every Friday equity session to 10:00-13:50.

entries.title: Overview of the Trading Week on TASE - 20 April 2026
entries.publisher: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange Research Unit
entries.notes: States that there will be no trading Tuesday and Wednesday due to Memorial Day and Independence Day, and that trading resumes Thursday.

entries.title: TASE Interim Report for the Period Ended 31 March 2026
entries.notes: Page 3 reports 62 actual trading days in Q1 2026. This corroborates an aggregate only and is not treated as evidence for individual closure dates.
